# Quotation -- RAUTAPORTTI-RFQ-2026-09

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla -- technical maintenance framework agreement

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy holds the required LUSA competence certificate.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.2 Service continuity through personnel changes is managed via our internal team structure.

4.3 We report to estate management on completed work and open faults.

4.4 Quality control and testing follow our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system.

4.5 Statutory periodic inspections of electrical installations are carried out as required.

4.6 Lift servicing is carried out in accordance with statutory requirements.

4.8 Installed equipment carries a standard warranty from commissioning.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 We accept a standard price-index clause.

5.4 Invoicing is monthly.

## 6. Forms

6.1 A certificate of pension insurance payments is attached.

6.2 An insurance certificate is attached.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.3 Spare parts are generally available from our Jyvaskyla depot within a few working days.

2.4 Fire-protection systems are serviced on a scheduled basis.

3.2 Visakoivu already does standby maintenance work and confirms it can cover the round-the-clock requirement.
